address: 1F, Sheraton Changzhou Wujin Hotel, 1 Yanzheng West Avenue, Wujin, Changzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: The Hong Kong-based brand started in 1991 and this outpost was opened its doors in a majestic hotel in 2010. With over 20 years of experience, chefs from Hong Kong are well versed in iconic Cantonese fare from seafood dishes and Cantonese barbecue to dim sum and stir-fries. Try their famous roast goose with wafer-thin, crackling skin and tender, juicy meat. Some seafood and barbecue dishes need pre-ordering. The elegant room provides the perfect foil for a culinary feast.
